empty: No matching items. Adjust search or filters.
about_text: Local macOS inspection. No telemetry or automatic repairs.
save_failed: Settings could not be saved; previous preferences retained.
settings_damaged: Some settings could not be read. Defaults are in use.

refresh_failed: Refresh failed. Previous results retained; d Diagnostics.
help_navigation_text: 1–5 switches directly to a section, including from menus and details. Arrows or j/k move. Enter opens details. Esc goes back one level; q closes the current view or quits immediately from the main screen. Search and path inputs keep keys as text.
help_lists_text: / searches this section. f filters. s sorts. r refreshes only this section. Collection never changes the inspected system.
help_inspection_text: Enter opens structured details. t shows technical evidence. App details: b tree, e expand directory, p plist, v signature, z bounded size.
help_copy_text: c opens copy scopes: section, group, filtered results or selected item. Highlight a scope: n copies names only; v adds versions (apps/Homebrew) or status (other sections); Enter copies the full report. y copies item details; x copies its path. Lists include every scoped row, even off screen.
help_access_text: , opens Language and Launch Intro. NO_COLOR and PEEK_NO_MOTION=1 disable decorative animation. d opens Diagnostics.
help_apps: App discovery is bounded. Declared bundle IDs are not verified ownership. v checks one local signature; no notarization or malware verdict is inferred.
help_brew: Local receipts and tap directories only. No dependency controls, updates, API lookups, repairs or remote fetches.
help_security: These six observed controls are not a security score. Unavailable and failed observations are not disabled states. No settings are changed.
help_services: Configured plists do not establish running state. Loaded/running observations have a domain and time scope. Login items remain outside verified coverage.
help_dev: Tool discovery resolves paths without running discovered binaries. Xcode selection uses the native read-only query. o opens an arbitrary app bundle. Diagnostics show collected sources only.
collision: Command collision. No unrelated command was overwritten.
removed: Peek removed. Thanks for taking a look.
remove_failed: Removal failed or is incomplete. Review the evidence below.
preserved: Source, settings, other installations and shell configuration are retained.
control_FileVault: Encrypts the startup volume while locked.
control_Gatekeeper: Assesses downloaded apps under macOS policy.
reveal_failed: Could not reveal the path; d Diagnostics.
source_system_provenance: Protected macOS location and Apple metadata; signature not implied.
source_declared_bundle: Declared bundle source; publisher authenticity not established.
source_local_distribution: Associated with a local Homebrew cask artifact.
source_verified_signer: Attribution based on the checked local signer.
source_unknown: Insufficient source evidence. See technical evidence.
preference_language: Choose the interface language. Names, paths and raw evidence stay unchanged.
preference_intro: Play the centered logo and slogan on launch. Any key skips it.
help_topics: Tab or Left/Right selects a topic. Up/Down scrolls. Esc returns.
accuracy_text: Source attribution and signature validation answer different questions. Declared metadata is not proof of authenticity. Unavailable means evidence is insufficient; an incomplete scan may omit items. Inspect technical evidence or Diagnostics for the basis and limits.
explain_apps: Apple uses protected macOS provenance where available. Third-party uses local distribution or coherent declared bundle evidence. Unavailable means those sources are insufficient. Enter opens details; t shows the basis; v checks the selected signature separately.
explain_brew: Formulae provide tools and libraries. Casks describe apps and artifacts. Taps are local package-source repositories. Requested means installed explicitly; unavailable receipt fields stay out of the controls.
explain_security: SIP protects system resources. FileVault encrypts the locked startup volume. Gatekeeper assesses downloaded apps. The application firewall controls incoming app connections. Enter explains one control; t shows native evidence. A failed query does not establish a disabled setting.
explain_services: Agents support a user session; daemons provide system services. Configured means a plist was found. Loaded means launchd observed the job; Running means a process was observed. Disabled is a separate domain override. A missing observation is Unknown, not proof of inactivity.
explain_dev: Environment explains the current shell and architecture. Xcode shows active tools. Runtime discovery resolves executable paths without running them. PATH Inspector reveals missing or duplicate search locations. Use Bundle Explorer for an unusual .app, and Diagnostics to understand incomplete results.
remove_invalid: Enter Y to remove Peek, or N to keep it.
app_unavailable: No installed GUI app is available for this item.
app_open_failed: Could not open the app; d Diagnostics.
help_open_app: o opens a validated installed GUI app from Applications or a cask with one verified app artifact. It never runs formulae, services, installer artifacts or loose executables.
control_Firewall Stealth: Reduces responses to unsolicited probes when the firewall is enabled.
control_Firewall Block All: Restricts incoming connections when the firewall is enabled. This optional policy is not a security score.
